reviews.title: Good product at a reasonable price, and reliable.
reviews.comment: I have used these 3 times to speed up two Lenovo laptops and a Dell desktop when migrating from Windows 10 to Windows 11 on compatible systems as they had the right drive connector available on the motherboard. This SSD made an amazing difference in system speed and responsiveness. So far very reliable.
reviews.author: George

reviews.title: Great Budget NVMe Upgrade
reviews.comment: Installed easily and was recognized immediately. It’s a great low-power SSD for a boot drive or upgrading an older system. Performance is noticeably faster than a SATA SSD or HDD for boot and general use. Solid value for the price, good read speed.
reviews.author: Pepe DI

reviews.title: Works OK
reviews.comment:
I was a bit skeptical having read some of the reviews. The price was certainly good. I have a five year old laptop where the NVMe drive was generating errors and going out. When the SSD arrived I attempted a clone operation from the old laptop drive but it was so full of errors the clone failed. (Not the fault of the new drive.) I decided to just replace the bad drive with this new one and load Windows11 from scratch. The operation went smoothly and soon I was up an running on the new drive. No more errors! It took most of the day to load the Microsoft Window updates and get my software loaded up again. The drive works great! I would purchase again if I had the need. I can't speak to longevity but parts is parts so who knows.
Update May 25; The Windows 11 event viewer reports NO drive errors. (The old bad drive was kicking out multiple drive errors.) The speed is very good and the laptop is running great. The laptop is being used everyday.
Update July 1; Came home and found the laptop was showing a HD failure. The drive failed and can't be recovered. Now I'm past the return date with Amazon and my data is lost. DON'T buy this drive as you get what you pay for!
reviews.author: S Thom

reviews.title: Patriots are #1 for me
reviews.comment: I have always liked patriot memory, so a hard drive has to kick butt. My older gamer machine has 2 16 gb sticks and she is about 10yrs old and still kicking. This HD is like a brick, and I have been using for months now. Fast boot and never has a lag issues. It has handled everything I have thrown at it......plus some.
reviews.author: Puffyeyed

reviews.title: Good nvme
reviews.comment:
Glad I got this before prices went insane, it's not the fastest nvme you will find but it's fast enough and didn't break the bank.
I'm using it as a boot drive for an Odroid M2 and it works great.
